name: Wicked The Are Compared To
overview: Scripture vividly portrays the wicked through a series of striking comparisons that emphasize their instability, worthlessness, and ultimate downfall. They are likened to chaff driven away by the wind and stubble before a storm, highlighting their lack of lasting strength or foundation (Psalms 1:4; Job 21:18). Their fleeting and insubstantial nature is further illustrated by images such as corn blasted before it matures and dreams or visions that vanish without a trace (2 Kings 19:26; Job 20:8). These metaphors collectively reveal the transient and powerless condition of the ungodly, contrasting sharply with the steadfastness of the righteous.
